title: Async RL Training
description: Concurrent rollout and Megatron training diagnostics. Select one run and job, then the execution processes to inspect. Missing telemetry is unknown, not zero.

params.value: SELECT run_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND name IN ('lifecycle','policy_step','rollout_call')) GROUP BY run_id HAVING run_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT job_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})) GROUP BY job_id HAVING job_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT execution_uid AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring})) GROUP BY execution_uid HAVING execution_uid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

panels.title: Optimizer and published policy steps
panels.description: Maximum reported optimizer step and published weight version per bucket, separated by execution. These gauges are not counter increments. Missing records do not establish a stall.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, name || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, MAX(CASE WHEN name='policy_step' THEN value ELSE CAST(json_get(body_json,'completed_update') AS DOUBLE) END) AS value FROM r WHERE name IN ('policy_step','policy_weights_published') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generated and consumed response tokens / s
panels.description: Native token increments divided by the bucket width, including idle time. Generated work can be consumed in later buckets or discarded; these rates are not same-cohort efficiency. Partial edge buckets can read low.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, json_get(attributes_json,'work_kind') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, SUM(value) * 1000.0 / ${__interval_ms} AS value FROM r WHERE name='work_completed' AND json_get(attributes_json,'work_kind') IN ('generated_token','consumed_response_token','consumed_loss_token') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Process lifecycle
panels.description: Latest lifecycle event per process, including startup failures. Completed collector processes do not establish successful training: require the trainer terminal and completed optimizer work. Execution IDs can differ between nodes in one job.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT execution_uid, json_get(resource_attributes_json,'role') AS role, COALESCE(json_get(resource_attributes_json,'actor_uid'),json_get(resource_attributes_json,'ray_task_id'),json_get(resource_attributes_json,'host')) AS process, name AS event, COALESCE(json_get(body_json,'status'),json_get(body_json,'state')) AS status, json_get(body_json,'reason') AS reason, timestamp_ms AS last_record_ms FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC,seq DESC) AS newest FROM r WHERE name IN ('lifecycle','terminal')) WHERE newest=1 ORDER BY last_record_ms DESC

panels.title: Driver step, preparation and policy walls
panels.description: Mean successful driver spans per bucket. Step, run_training and train_critic_and_policy are nested, so never add them. Checkpoint and evaluation time are outside the step wall.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, AVG(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase') IN ('step','wait_for_generation_buffer','run_training','fwd_logprobs_values_reward','train_critic_and_policy') AND COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'outcome'),'success')='success' AND json_get(attributes_json,'role')='trainer' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Producer await duration
panels.description: Mean is total wait seconds divided by the number of awaits, not the average of per-call sums. Max retains the longest await. Slot waits are admission backpressure; concurrent wait totals are not driver wall time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t, json_get(attributes_json,'wait') || ' mean' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series, SUM(CASE WHEN name='rollout_wait_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'stat')='sum' THEN value END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN name='rollout_wait_count' THEN value END),0) AS value FROM r WHERE name IN ('rollout_wait_seconds','rollout_wait_count') GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'wait') || ' max' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MAX(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_wait_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'stat')='max' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Completed buffer depth and capacity
panels.description: Last observed completed-group depth and queue capacity in each bucket, per execution. Capacity is the queue limit, not available staleness credits. Sampled zeros can miss short occupancy bursts.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT t,name || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM (SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)),execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name ORDER BY timestamp_ms DESC,seq DESC) AS newest FROM r WHERE name IN ('rollout_queue_depth','rollout_capacity')) WHERE newest=1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumed buffer dwell
panels.description: Time from group completion to admission for consumed groups. High dwell means generated work waits for the consumer. Discarded-group dwell is excluded.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'p50' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.5) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='consumed' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'p95' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.95) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='consumed' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'max' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MAX(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='consumed' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consumed policy staleness
panels.description: Policy versions behind at consumption, one observation per admitted group. This excludes rejected groups; inspect the group-outcome ledger for discarded work.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'p50' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.5) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_staleness_steps' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'p95' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.95) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_staleness_steps' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'max' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MAX(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_staleness_steps' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Successful rollout-call latency
panels.description: Per-call elapsed wall, not a step generation wall. Calls overlap; their durations cannot be summed into elapsed training time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'p50' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.5) AS value FROM r WHERE name='phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='rollout_call' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'p95' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,approx_percentile_cont(value,0.95) AS value FROM r WHERE name='phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='rollout_call' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'max' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MAX(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='rollout_call' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Policy drains and weight synchronization
panels.description: Driver-observed phase durations; outcomes remain separate. Pause can wait for inference, and drains can wait for policy ranks. These are elapsed awaits, not GPU kernel timings.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' ' || COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'outcome'),'success') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,AVG(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase') IN ('policy_pre_train_drain','policy_pre_sync_drain','policy_post_sync_drain','weight_pause','weight_broadcast','weight_resume') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Driver event-loop lag
panels.description: Maximum scheduling delay in each bucket. Includes startup and initial evaluation; inspect the time window before calling it a steady-state slowdown.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,'max lag' || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MAX(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='event_loop_lag_seconds' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Signed timing residuals
panels.description: Minimum signed residual per bucket, split by timing root and rank. Negative values can expose overlapping child accounting; they are not clamped. Rollout driver and Megatron worker clocks are independent.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' rank ' || COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'rank'),'driver') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,MIN(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='phase_duration_seconds' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase') IN ('rollout_call_residual','megatron_policy_train_residual') AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Concurrent work and terminal group outcomes
Rollouts completing during policy training
panels.description: Successful calls returning while the driver awaits policy training, grouped by optimizer step. Null means no successful rollout records, or an interval estimated to begin before the selected window. Interval start is estimated from its completion-event timestamp and monotonic duration. Narrow-window edge estimates have publication/clock uncertainty. Zero is a valid observed result; this is completion overlap, not CUDA kernel overlap or utilization.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), p AS (SELECT timestamp_ms - 1000.0 * (CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished') AS DOUBLE) - CAST(json_get(body_json,'started') AS DOUBLE)) AS estimated_started_ms,execution_uid,resource_attributes_json AS process,CAST(json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS BIGINT) AS step,CAST(json_get(body_json,'started') AS DOUBLE) AS started,CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished') AS DOUBLE) AS finished FROM r WHERE name='policy_training_interval' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success'), c AS (SELECT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json AS process,json_get(body_json,'call_id') AS call_id,CAST(json_get(body_json,'started') AS DOUBLE) AS started,CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished') AS DOUBLE) AS finished,CAST(json_get(body_json,'response_tokens') AS BIGINT) AS tokens FROM r WHERE name='rollout_call' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success'), coverage AS (SELECT execution_uid,process,COUNT(*) AS calls FROM c GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT p.execution_uid,p.step,CASE WHEN MIN(p.estimated_started_ms)<CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) THEN 'partial interval' WHEN MAX(coverage.calls) IS NULL THEN 'no rollout records' ELSE 'observed' END AS coverage,CASE WHEN MIN(p.estimated_started_ms)>=CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND MAX(coverage.calls)>0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.call_id) END AS completed_calls,CASE WHEN MIN(p.estimated_started_ms)>=CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND MAX(coverage.calls)>0 THEN COALESCE(SUM(c.tokens),0) END AS returned_tokens FROM p LEFT JOIN coverage ON p.execution_uid=coverage.execution_uid AND p.process=coverage.process LEFT JOIN c ON p.execution_uid=c.execution_uid AND p.process=c.process AND c.started<p.finished AND c.finished>=p.started AND c.finished<p.finished GROUP BY p.execution_uid,p.process,p.step ORDER BY p.step

panels.title: Group outcomes / bucket
panels.description: Native terminal outcome increments, separated from restored-buffer credit. Consumed, rejected and shutdown-pending work have distinct meanings. A time window can start after generation or end before disposition; these bucket totals are not cohort efficiency.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'outcome') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,SUM(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_group_count' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens by group outcome / bucket
panels.description: Native terminal outcome increments, separated from restored-buffer credit. Consumed, rejected and shutdown-pending work have distinct meanings. A time window can start after generation or end before disposition; these bucket totals are not cohort efficiency.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '${__interval_ms} milliseconds', to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms)) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'outcome') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,SUM(value) AS value FROM r WHERE name='rollout_group_tokens' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Training reward and informative groups
panels.description: Logged training scalars at the optimizer step. Pass@4 and informative-group fraction are distinct. Changing prompt batches and four-step smokes do not establish learning significance.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' ' || json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('reward/avg_raw_reward','reward/avg_pass_at_4','reward/informative_group_fraction') ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.title: Evaluation scores
panels.description: Held-out evaluation scores mirrored from the tracker. Values occur only at evaluation steps; blank means no evaluation records in this window, not zero accuracy.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' ' || json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%' ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.title: Consumed length stops and coverage
panels.description: Length-stop fraction uses admitted response sequences before DP padding, and is published only after the learner update completes. Coverage is the fraction of those sequences with a recorded stop reason. A length stop means the engine or runner exhausted a length budget; it does not prove the answer is incomplete. Missing fractions remain gaps rather than zero, including steps with incomplete coverage.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), s AS (SELECT execution_uid,json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS step,MAX(timestamp_ms) AS timestamp_ms,MAX(CASE WHEN json_get(attributes_json,'metric')='consumed/length_stop_fraction' THEN value END) AS length_fraction,MAX(CASE WHEN json_get(attributes_json,'metric')='consumed/stop_reason_coverage' THEN value END) AS coverage FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='train' AND json_get(attributes_json,'role')='trainer' AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('consumed/length_stop_fraction','consumed/stop_reason_coverage') GROUP BY execution_uid,json_get(attributes_json,'step')) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,'consumed/length_stop_fraction · ' || execution_uid AS series,CASE WHEN coverage=1 THEN length_fraction END AS value FROM s UNION ALL SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,'consumed/stop_reason_coverage · ' || execution_uid AS series,coverage AS value FROM s ORDER BY t,series

panels.title: Optimizer diagnostics
panels.description: Finite loss, entropy, KL and gradient-norm observations. These have different meanings and are not additive. Nonfinite values are counted separately in telemetry health.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' ' || json_get(attributes_json,'phase') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('policy/policy_entropy','policy/entropy','policy/grad_norm','policy/raw_grad_norm','policy/policy_kl','policy/final_loss','policy/policy_loss') ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.title: Megatron policy wall by rank
panels.description: Host-observed dispatch/blocking wall per worker, bounded by existing collectives. No additional CUDA synchronization is inserted. Do not sum ranks into total wall.

panels.title: Learner memory by phase
panels.description: PyTorch native allocator observations, per worker/GPU in the selected window. Peaks include the resident baseline; reserved bytes include allocator cache. Current bytes and device free bytes are boundary samples, not interval minima of the whole device. Model-ready precedes lazy Adam allocation and has no interval peak. Missing telemetry is unknown; initialization, checkpoint and export peaks are excluded.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

params.value:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), m AS (SELECT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,json_get(attributes_json,'rank') AS rank,json_get(attributes_json,'gpu_uuid') AS gpu,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') AS phase,body_json FROM r WHERE name='cuda_memory_observation' AND json_get(attributes_json,'worker_role')='policy')
SELECT execution_uid AS execution,json_get(resource_attributes_json,'host') AS host,rank,gpu,phase,COUNT(*) AS observations,
MAX(CAST(json_get(body_json,'peak_allocated_bytes') AS DOUBLE))/1073741824 AS peak_allocated_gib,
MAX(CAST(json_get(body_json,'peak_reserved_bytes') AS DOUBLE))/1073741824 AS peak_reserved_gib,
MAX(CAST(json_get(body_json,'allocated_bytes') AS DOUBLE))/1073741824 AS sampled_allocated_gib,
MIN(CAST(json_get(body_json,'device_free_bytes') AS DOUBLE))/1073741824 AS sampled_free_gib,
MAX(CAST(json_get(body_json,'device_total_bytes') AS DOUBLE))/1073741824 AS device_total_gib
FROM m GROUP BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,rank,gpu,phase ORDER BY execution,rank,phase

panels.title: Inference sampled throughput by learner phase
panels.description: Reset-safe imported vLLM token counters aligned with driver UTC phase windows. Only sample intervals wholly inside one successful phase count; reset and boundary-crossing intervals are excluded. Rate is tokens divided by covered sample seconds, not whole phase duration. Coverage reveals gaps; NULL rate means unobserved, not idle. Collector process and unique engine identity are preserved. This measures sampled service, not GPU execution or exact kernel overlap; collection delay and clock alignment limit precision.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

params.value:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), windows AS (
SELECT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,seq,json_get(attributes_json,'phase') AS phase,
CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS started_ms,
CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS BIGINT) AS finished_ms
FROM r WHERE name='async_phase_window' AND json_get(attributes_json,'outcome')='success'
AND CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS BIGINT)>CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS BIGINT)
AND ABS((CAST(json_get(body_json,'finished_unix_ms') AS DOUBLE)-CAST(json_get(body_json,'started_unix_ms') AS DOUBLE))/1000-CAST(json_get(body_json,'duration_seconds') AS DOUBLE))<0.005
), counters AS (
SELECT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,json_get(attributes_json,'engine') AS engine,
COALESCE(json_get(attributes_json,'model_name'),'') AS model,timestamp_ms,seq,value
FROM r WHERE name IN ('generation_tokens_total','prompt_tokens_total')
AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric_source')='vllm'
AND json_get(attributes_json,'source_temporality')='cumulative_snapshot'
AND json_get(attributes_json,'engine') IS NOT NULL
), lagged AS (
SELECT *,LAG(timestamp_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,engine,model ORDER BY timestamp_ms,seq) AS previous_ms,
LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,engine,model ORDER BY timestamp_ms,seq) AS previous_value FROM counters
), engines AS (SELECT DISTINCT execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,name,engine,model FROM counters), per_window AS (
SELECT w.execution_uid,w.resource_attributes_json,w.seq,w.phase,e.name,e.engine,e.model,
(w.finished_ms-w.started_ms)/1000.0 AS window_seconds,
SUM(l.value-l.previous_value) AS tokens,SUM((l.timestamp_ms-l.previous_ms)/1000.0) AS covered_seconds,COUNT(l.timestamp_ms) AS intervals
FROM windows w JOIN engines e ON w.execution_uid=e.execution_uid AND w.resource_attributes_json=e.resource_attributes_json
LEFT JOIN lagged l ON e.execution_uid=l.execution_uid AND e.resource_attributes_json=l.resource_attributes_json AND e.name=l.name AND e.engine=l.engine AND e.model=l.model
AND l.previous_ms>=w.started_ms AND l.timestamp_ms<=w.finished_ms AND l.timestamp_ms>l.previous_ms AND l.value>=l.previous_value
GROUP BY w.execution_uid,w.resource_attributes_json,w.seq,w.phase,e.name,e.engine,e.model,w.started_ms,w.finished_ms
)
SELECT execution_uid AS execution,json_get(resource_attributes_json,'host') AS collector,phase,engine,model,name AS counter,
SUM(tokens)/NULLIF(SUM(covered_seconds),0) AS tokens_per_sampled_second,
COALESCE(SUM(covered_seconds),0)/NULLIF(SUM(window_seconds),0) AS coverage_fraction,
SUM(intervals) AS intervals,SUM(window_seconds) AS phase_seconds
FROM per_window GROUP BY execution_uid,resource_attributes_json,phase,engine,model,name ORDER BY execution,phase,engine,counter

panels.title: Cumulative core GPU-hours in selected window
panels.description: Core step seconds × configured policy plus inference GPUs / 3600, accumulated only over complete metric rows in the selected window. This charges allocated role time, including idle waits; it is not active GPU execution. Excludes startup, evaluation, checkpoint/export and gaps outside the core. Use whole-job allocated GPU-hours for billing comparisons.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), steps AS (
SELECT execution_uid,json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS step,MAX(timestamp_ms) AS timestamp_ms,
MAX(CASE WHEN json_get(attributes_json,'metric')='async/performance/core_seconds' THEN value END) AS seconds,
MAX(CASE WHEN json_get(attributes_json,'metric')='async/performance/configured_policy_gpus' THEN value END) AS policy_gpus,
MAX(CASE WHEN json_get(attributes_json,'metric')='async/performance/configured_inference_gpus' THEN value END) AS inference_gpus
FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='train'
AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('async/performance/core_seconds','async/performance/configured_policy_gpus','async/performance/configured_inference_gpus')
GROUP BY execution_uid,json_get(attributes_json,'step'))
SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,'core GPU-hours · ' || execution_uid AS series,
SUM(seconds*(policy_gpus+inference_gpus)/3600) OVER (PARTITION BY execution_uid ORDER BY CAST(step AS BIGINT) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS value
FROM steps WHERE seconds IS NOT NULL AND policy_gpus IS NOT NULL AND inference_gpus IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.title: Wire-weight change survey by publication
panels.description: Opt-in bounded survey of exact converted BF16/FP32 wire bits. Changed and hypothetical uint32-index plus replacement-value payload fractions are estimates, not gradient sparsity or measured compression speedups. Baseline/incomplete publications have no change estimate. Capture, CUDA and compare timings overlap and must not be summed. Dense wire inventory may include tied tensors more than once. No codec is enabled by this probe.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT execution_uid AS execution,CAST(json_get(body_json,'target_update') AS BIGINT) AS update,json_get(body_json,'status') AS status,CAST(json_get(body_json,'coverage_complete') AS BIGINT) AS complete,CAST(json_get(body_json,'dense_wire_bytes') AS DOUBLE) AS dense_bytes,CAST(json_get(body_json,'estimated_changed_element_fraction') AS DOUBLE) AS changed_fraction,CAST(json_get(body_json,'estimated_index32_value_bytes') AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(CAST(json_get(body_json,'dense_wire_bytes') AS DOUBLE),0) AS patch_fraction,CAST(json_get(body_json,'capture_enqueue_seconds') AS DOUBLE) AS capture_seconds,CAST(json_get(body_json,'sample_cuda_milliseconds') AS DOUBLE) AS cuda_ms,CAST(json_get(body_json,'compare_commit_seconds') AS DOUBLE) AS compare_seconds FROM r WHERE name='weight_change_probe' ORDER BY timestamp_ms

panels.description: Only optimizer batches with native async/staleness_min = async/staleness_max at an exact nonnegative integer age. Rows preserve run, job and execution identity. Mixed-age batches are excluded: aggregate drift cannot be decomposed by group age. Requires complete, finite diagnostics and full reported-behavior coverage; conflicting duplicate step metrics are excluded. Response length = summed consumed response tokens / summed sequences. MSLR = consumed-loss-token-weighted mean of batch mean squared learner/reported-behavior log ratio. ESS is the minimum batch token-weight ESS fraction; raw reward is the unweighted mean of batch means. These are selected-population associations, not isolated temporal KL or a causal age effect. Informative fraction is omitted because its group denominator varies with training mode. See token coverage alongside.

defaults.noValue: No matching diagnostics.

params.value:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), metrics AS (
 SELECT run_id,job_id,execution_uid,CAST(json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS BIGINT) AS step,
 json_get(attributes_json,'metric') AS metric,MIN(value) AS minimum,MAX(value) AS maximum,COUNT(*) AS samples,COUNT(value) AS values_present
 FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='train'
 AND CAST(json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS BIGINT)>0 AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('async/staleness_min','async/staleness_max','async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens','async/performance/consumed_response_tokens','consumed/sequences','policy/behavior_drift/mean_squared_log_ratio','policy/behavior_drift/token_weight_ess_fraction','reward/avg_raw_reward','policy/behavior_drift/finite_fraction','policy/behavior_drift/missing_behavior','policy/policy_loss')
 GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step,metric
), batches AS (
 SELECT run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step,MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/staleness_min' THEN maximum END) AS age_min, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/staleness_max' THEN maximum END) AS age_max, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens' THEN maximum END) AS loss_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_response_tokens' THEN maximum END) AS response_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='consumed/sequences' THEN maximum END) AS sequences, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/mean_squared_log_ratio' THEN maximum END) AS mslr, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/token_weight_ess_fraction' THEN maximum END) AS ess, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='reward/avg_raw_reward' THEN maximum END) AS reward, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/finite_fraction' THEN maximum END) AS finite_fraction, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/missing_behavior' THEN maximum END) AS missing_behavior, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/policy_loss' THEN maximum END) AS policy_loss,
 SUM(CASE WHEN minimum<>maximum OR samples<>values_present THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens' AND (samples<>values_present OR minimum<>maximum OR minimum<0 OR maximum>=1e308 OR maximum<>FLOOR(maximum)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_conflicts
 FROM metrics GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN conflicts=0 AND age_min=age_max AND age_min>=0 AND age_min=FLOOR(age_min)
 AND loss_tokens>0 AND loss_tokens<1e308 AND loss_tokens=FLOOR(loss_tokens)
 AND response_tokens>=0 AND response_tokens<1e308 AND response_tokens=FLOOR(response_tokens) AND sequences>0 AND sequences<1e308 AND sequences=FLOOR(sequences)
 AND mslr>=0 AND mslr<1e308 AND ess>0 AND ess<=1 AND finite_fraction=1 AND missing_behavior=0
 AND reward BETWEEN -1e308 AND 1e308 AND policy_loss BETWEEN -1e308 AND 1e308 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible
 FROM batches
), grouped AS (
 SELECT 'Uniform-age batches' AS status,execution_uid AS execution,CAST(age_min AS BIGINT) AS age,
 COUNT(*) AS updates,SUM(response_tokens)/SUM(sequences) AS mean_response_tokens,
 SUM(mslr*loss_tokens)/SUM(loss_tokens) AS token_weighted_mslr,MIN(ess) AS minimum_ess_fraction,
 AVG(reward) AS mean_update_raw_reward
 FROM classified WHERE eligible=1 GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,age_min
)
SELECT * FROM grouped
UNION ALL
SELECT 'No qualifying uniform-age batches' AS status,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS execution,CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS age,CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS updates,
 CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS mean_response_tokens,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS token_weighted_mslr,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS minimum_ess_fraction,CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS mean_update_raw_reward
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM grouped)
ORDER BY execution,age

panels.title: Uniform-age batch diagnostics

panels.description: Fraction of all observed consumed loss tokens represented in the uniform-age table, across the selected runs/jobs/executions and time window. The denominator includes mixed-age batches and batches missing other diagnostics. The numerator excludes them. Null means no observed tokens or conflicting/invalid token counts, not zero or full coverage. This is telemetry-selection coverage, not proof that unobserved batches do not exist. Query fields also report observed, represented and mixed-age token counts plus included/excluded batch counts. Mixed-age batch drift is never attributed to individual ages.

defaults.noValue: No valid token denominator

params.value:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})), metrics AS (
 SELECT run_id,job_id,execution_uid,CAST(json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS BIGINT) AS step,
 json_get(attributes_json,'metric') AS metric,MIN(value) AS minimum,MAX(value) AS maximum,COUNT(*) AS samples,COUNT(value) AS values_present
 FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND json_get(attributes_json,'phase')='train'
 AND CAST(json_get(attributes_json,'step') AS BIGINT)>0 AND json_get(attributes_json,'metric') IN ('async/staleness_min','async/staleness_max','async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens','async/performance/consumed_response_tokens','consumed/sequences','policy/behavior_drift/mean_squared_log_ratio','policy/behavior_drift/token_weight_ess_fraction','reward/avg_raw_reward','policy/behavior_drift/finite_fraction','policy/behavior_drift/missing_behavior','policy/policy_loss')
 GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step,metric
), batches AS (
 SELECT run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step,MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/staleness_min' THEN maximum END) AS age_min, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/staleness_max' THEN maximum END) AS age_max, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens' THEN maximum END) AS loss_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_response_tokens' THEN maximum END) AS response_tokens, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='consumed/sequences' THEN maximum END) AS sequences, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/mean_squared_log_ratio' THEN maximum END) AS mslr, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/token_weight_ess_fraction' THEN maximum END) AS ess, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='reward/avg_raw_reward' THEN maximum END) AS reward, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/finite_fraction' THEN maximum END) AS finite_fraction, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/behavior_drift/missing_behavior' THEN maximum END) AS missing_behavior, MAX(CASE WHEN metric='policy/policy_loss' THEN maximum END) AS policy_loss,
 SUM(CASE WHEN minimum<>maximum OR samples<>values_present THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN metric='async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens' AND (samples<>values_present OR minimum<>maximum OR minimum<0 OR maximum>=1e308 OR maximum<>FLOOR(maximum)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_conflicts
 FROM metrics GROUP BY run_id,job_id,execution_uid,step
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN conflicts=0 AND age_min=age_max AND age_min>=0 AND age_min=FLOOR(age_min)
 AND loss_tokens>0 AND loss_tokens<1e308 AND loss_tokens=FLOOR(loss_tokens)
 AND response_tokens>=0 AND response_tokens<1e308 AND response_tokens=FLOOR(response_tokens) AND sequences>0 AND sequences<1e308 AND sequences=FLOOR(sequences)
 AND mslr>=0 AND mslr<1e308 AND ess>0 AND ess<=1 AND finite_fraction=1 AND missing_behavior=0
 AND reward BETWEEN -1e308 AND 1e308 AND policy_loss BETWEEN -1e308 AND 1e308 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible
 FROM batches
)
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(loss_conflicts)=0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN eligible=1 THEN loss_tokens ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(loss_tokens),0) ELSE NULL END AS uniform_age_token_fraction,
 CASE WHEN SUM(loss_conflicts)=0 THEN SUM(loss_tokens) ELSE NULL END AS observed_loss_tokens,
 SUM(CASE WHEN eligible=1 THEN loss_tokens ELSE 0 END) AS represented_loss_tokens,
 SUM(CASE WHEN age_min<age_max AND age_min>=0 AND age_min=FLOOR(age_min) AND age_max=FLOOR(age_max) THEN loss_tokens ELSE 0 END) AS mixed_age_loss_tokens,
 SUM(CASE WHEN eligible=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uniform_updates,
 SUM(CASE WHEN eligible=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_updates
FROM classified

panels.title: Uniform-age diagnostic token coverage
Evaluation response length and stop coverage
panels.description: Finalized trajectory response lengths (mean/max; left axis), native length/completed stop fractions and stop-reason coverage (right axis). Fractions are emitted only with full stop coverage; absent historical or incomplete observations remain gaps. Length stops include budget exhaustion and do not necessarily mean an incorrect answer. Completed labels are exactly complete/end_turn/eos/stop; these do not certify a semantic final answer, natural model EOS, or balanced thinking. Other nonempty labels such as abort are known but in neither class. Dataset and execution identities remain separate.

defaults.noValue: No supplemental evaluation observations

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND (json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/response_tokens_mean' OR json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/response_tokens_max' OR json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/length_stop_fraction' OR json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/completed_stop_fraction' OR json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/stop_reason_coverage') ORDER BY timestamp_ms,seq

panels.title: Evaluation score contributions by stop class
panels.description: Raw avg_score alongside contributions from length-stopped and completed-stop trajectories. Each contribution sums the same optimization scores used by avg_score (scalar score or sum of token rewards), divided by ALL evaluation sequences in that dataset; these are not conditional accuracies. Contributions require full stop coverage and are absent on legacy runs. Other known stops (for example abort) can carry score, so the two contributions need not sum to avg_score. Finished stops do not certify semantic answer completeness or balanced thinking; the primary scorer is unchanged.

defaults.noValue: No supplemental evaluation observations

params.value: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring}) AND execution_uid IN (${execution:sqlstring})) SELECT to_timestamp_millis(timestamp_ms) AS t,json_get(attributes_json,'metric') || ' · ' || execution_uid AS series,value FROM r WHERE name='training_metric_value' AND (json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/avg_score' OR json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/length_stop_score_contribution' OR json_get(attributes_json,'metric') LIKE 'eval/%/completed_stop_score_contribution') ORDER BY timestamp_ms,seq
